notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (statements show fund balances); business-type funds are accrual. As in the FY2025 extraction, beginning_cash/ending_cash are the Total Governmental Funds fund balances (2,677,257 and 2,539,313, p5); governmental funds balance sheet total assets 2,542,168 less 2,855 payroll withholdings payable (p4). Note proceeds 205,000 printed inside Revenues (General Fund, Solid Waste department) recorded as debt_proceeds; printed total revenues 3,235,719 include it. Transfers: Street Fund +512,277 and Debt Service Fund -512,277 net to '-' in Total column; recorded gross from fund columns (p5, p11, p12). Business-type: no single printed total; receipts/disbursements computed from operating + nonoperating lines (p7). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (includes capital assets and debt, so the governmental funds balance sheet is not used); component unit (Neligh Library Foundation) excluded. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departments combining statement (pp15-16), which is more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p9), so the budget schedule lines are not recorded; Street and Debt Service from their budget schedules (pp11-12; Street 'Bond proceeds' budget 250,000 with no actual not recorded); six nonmajor funds from the combining statement (pp13-14). 'In lieu' in the departments schedule (204,301 total) equals the statement's Occupation tax. Departmental Salaries and benefits is one combined line recorded as salaries and wages. No budget schedule for proprietary funds. Read pages 1-16 of 16
